title: Kauffman Center for Performing Arts
author: ADC
concept: We visited this site in Spring 2026 as 2nd year students in architecture. The video shows the grand scale of the theatre and documents our visit. This particular space features an instrument called the 'Casavant Organ' which the hall was designed after.

title: The Timberlands
author: ADC
concept: This video entry features a short talk and QnA with one of the architects at Grafton Architects. As well as a breakdown of the construction of The Timberlands.

title: Thorncrown Chapel
author: ADC
concept: A building by E. Fay Jones which we had the chance to visit. The site is very secluded and uses glass in a way to blend into the surrounding nature.

title: Iowa City
author: Marcos Montes de Oca
concept: Documentation of a building expressed through a poem. Summer break 2026.

title: Chicago
author: Brian Ibarra
concept: My first time in Chicago. What surreal experience let alone being on an architectural field trip with friends on a boat tour around the city. The city is beautiful. To capture that beauty, I captured these succinct moments on the boat right as we cruised from landmark to landmark. I purposely took some square photos. I love square photos ☺
